hooks.text: 僵尸会追踪位置、改变路线并合并成集体狩猎尸群
hooks.excerpt: Our unique pathfinding system enables them to intelligently move through the city, adjusting their routes based on your position. When they spot others nearby, they merge into dangerous hunting hordes.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 营地同时维持士气、卫生、住所与资源，并审查入营幸存者
hooks.excerpt: When morale, hygiene, shelter, and resources fall out of balance, order within the camp quickly collapses. Keep the fire burning, build shelters, clean up poop, and maintain survivor morale. Every decision you make directly shapes the future of your camp. The Future of Your Camp is in Your Hands Some survivors will want to join your camp and improve your chances of survival, but you cannot know who will turn into a zombie as they may hide it from you. Be careful and check everyone at the gate.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 扩展背包并合并物品腾出空间，按生存流派重组库存
hooks.excerpt: Find backpacks and expand them to carry more items. Merge items to free up space and customize your backpack to match your playstyle while exploring the city and fighting zombies.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
